rows.target_quote: Safe and efficient embodied agents require a reliable answer to a basic question at every decision step: which of the available actions can actually be executed given the current physical state? Without a module that filters out physically infeasible actions, an agent wastes steps testing impossible interactions, risks irreversible failures, and places an unnecessary burden on its reasoning or planning components to recover.
